Models, copilots and agents now run in every business unit, on every cloud — and the same gaps appear everywhere: shadow AI, governance rebuilt app by app, runaway cost, agents that act faster than any reviewer, and audit evidence scattered across spreadsheets. Kosmoy puts four layers of control around every AI a company runs: - INVENTORY — every AI system, model, MCP server and agent registered with an owner and a risk tier. The master agent registry pulls agents automatically from Azure AI Foundry, Bedrock, Vertex, Salesforce and ServiceNow; anything unregistered is flagged as shadow AI. - MONITORING — every call watched: cost, usage and behaviour by model, app and user, with budgets that warn and then block. - GOVERNANCE — one OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway enforcing guardrails, RBAC, routing and logging on every LLM, MCP and agent-to-agent call. - ACTION CONTROL — Action Capsules: kernel-enforced sandboxes in your own Kubernetes that contain autonomous agents, with just-in-time credentials and a kill switch. The same registries and gateway logs produce audit-ready evidence for the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF. Kosmoy is software you run, not a service you send prompts to — single-tenant in your own Kubernetes on Azure, AWS, GCP or on-prem. In production at Banca d'Italia and Leonardo. S&P Global initiated analyst coverage in March 2026. Milan (HQ) · New York · Bu
